title: Europe-Focused CBEC Platform Voghion Raises Multi-$10M A and A+
summary: On Sep 26, 2022, Europe-facing CBEC platform Voghion (Singapore HQ, founded 2021) closed multi-$10M A + A+ from Focus Tech, Dongda Capital, Baika Capital, and angels — for logistics/supply-chain edge. Hit Europe top-10 downloads in one month; 10k+ daily orders. ~10k merchants
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · October 14, 2022

On Sep 26, 2022, Europe-facing CBEC platform Voghion (Singapore HQ, founded 2021) closed multi-$10M A + A+ from Focus Tech, Dongda Capital, Baika Capital, and angels — for logistics/supply-chain edge. Hit Europe top-10 downloads in one month; 10k+ daily orders. ~10k merchants from South/East China belts; 40+ EU countries (FR/DE/UK/BE/ES/GR…). Differentiator “platform express”: 7-day delivery to mainstream EU vs AliExpress 10–25 days via China consolidation. AI recommend + automated ads; 24h PH CS. Thesis: Europe ecom ~$850B but Amazon only ~10% — room for new platforms. Team ex-Alibaba/Pinduoduo/AliExpress/Wish.

— END —
